ops.title: cookiesync v0.30.0: first Linux release (PR #3 + import PR #4), verified public by root
ops.body:
Release v0.30.0 is the first cookiesync release with Linux (amd64) support and the memory-only `cookiesync import` primitive.

- Source: PR #3 (Linux port, head 4007966) merged to main at 47b26b5; PR #4 (import child, head 4119568) merged at e7c4e6a; metadata PR #5 merged at 44d85ed.
- Tag: immutable annotated `v0.30.0` (tag object 4001e01d) peels to 44d85ed, whose main workflows were green (CI 36787775158, Guides 36787775623, cc-notes 36787775022).
- Publication (root-verified, bus #487): Release run 36788055650 and the cask publish both succeeded; release ID 400495996 is non-draft/non-prerelease with exactly six assets; every SHA256 matched the API, the checksums file and the zip sidecar. Linux archive `cookiesync_linux_amd64.tar.gz` is an x86_64 ELF, SHA256 `ebf612ca04c3ba1ab300bc5e8ba6719f582996b1d26c60321a977d16f28e48c0`; cask 0.30.0 ZIP SHA `f3448e88267c33abe24565d6f4afdddde5e3df47cb1244464d2dfa62b865a9af`.
- Proof: `~/.local/state/orca-workspace/recovery-20260930/cookiesync-v0.30.0-verification.json` (root) and `recovery-20260930/cookiesync-linux/cookiesync-linux-implementation.md` (this lane's final report).
- Nothing was installed or restarted on the Mac; VM-bootstrap (main's lane) may pin this release.
- Final-read diagnostics rule that shaped the last two import commits: refusals name only indexes, schema field names, or JSON byte offsets — never document content (7d12478 cookie index, 4119568 fixed unknown-field message).
